description: Fine-tune any photo with independent brightness and contrast sliders, previewed live.

faqs.a: Brightness shifts every pixel lighter or darker; contrast stretches or compresses the tonal range around mid-grey.
faqs.q: What do the two sliders do?

faqs.a: Yes — move either slider and the preview updates in real time.
A lossless PNG at the original dimensions.

howto: Drop an image into the tool.
Drag the brightness and contrast sliders until it looks right.
Click Download PNG to save it.
title: Image Brightness & Contrast
